 Comment React Share Tiafoe Joins Fritz, Nakashima and Tien at the 2027 Delray Beach Open
 Frances Tiafoe will return to the Delray Beach Open in 2027, a tournament filled with emotion for the American, who won his first ATP title there in 2018. Taylor Fritz, Brandon Nakashima, and Learner Tien will also be in action in Florida.
 NEW YORK, NEW YORK - SEPTEMBER 11: Frances Tiafoe of the United States celebrates a point against Ben Shelton of the United States during their men's singles semifinal match on Day Thirteen of the 2026 US Open at the USTA Billie Jean King National Tennis Center on September 11, 2026 in the Flushing neighborhood of the Queens borough of New York City. © JULIAN FINNEY / Getty Images via AFP Clément Gehl 11/11/2026, 15:24 1 min to read Follow us Fritz Nakashima Tiafoe Tien The field for the 2027 Delray Beach Open continues to take shape. Frances Tiafoe has confirmed his participation in the next edition of the American ATP 250, which will run from February 12 to 21 in Florida.
 He will join three compatriots already announced: Taylor Fritz, Brandon Nakashima, and Learner Tien.
 Remove ads This return will carry special meaning for Tiafoe. The American won his very first ATP title at Delray Beach in 2018, at just 20 years old.
 Four Top 25 Americans Announced
 The organizers will be able to count on a strong showing from American tennis. Taylor Fritz, a two-time champion of the tournament in 2023 and 2024, will be chasing a third trophy.
 Brandon Nakashima and Learner Tien will also be in the draw, after both took major steps forward in recent seasons.
